entry: tools/Run_U04_Board.command --input-dir <explicit absolute raw directory> [--crop <explicit absolute image path> | --whole-board]
local_code: python3 tools/pcb_u04_board_operator.py start --input-dir <explicit absolute raw directory> [--crop <explicit absolute image path>]
scope: Fresh T01 → exact retain-valid-paths T03 → unchanged source-bound T04 → source-bound T02 whole-rectangle and connected inclusive growth; no rendering, T05 or later stages.

policy.port_authority: Fresh T01 source-derived ports; independently regenerate and compare before T03
policy.objective: Required remediation of actual T01 growth, not optional enlargement opportunity

input: One explicit raw directory; native intake only; inherited participating-layer correspondence and excluded-companion accounting
audit: One separate audit per actual native operation. Terminal deterministic machine proofs independently re-evaluated by route; Local Code distinct observations; no audit-mode substitution.

width_policy.route_definition: Existing source_junction_paths: complete same-width paths with exact original junction boundaries; no electrical inference
width_policy.parallel_definition: Existing parallel_relation parameters 1 degree / .25 mm projection / .5 mm transverse distance plus finite-copper cross-section blockers
width_policy.fully_covered: KEEP only with exact complete predecessor coverage proof; no partial-coverage skip

crop_selection: Actual image file read only by native intake, staged byte-identical and hash-bound. Same PCB data-ABI source constellation/mask/landmark location predicates. Two separate location/audit gates precede T01. No saved crop-name mapping, no candidate copper from pixels.
crop_scope: Only complete circle growth envelopes and complete native width paths/parallel groups inside the verified window (inset by location uncertainty) are writable. All source copper remains context; outside and crossing features are protected. Full-board candidate exports remain audited.

crop_landmark_observability.hypotheses: Visible round-peak witnesses; bulk copper cannot set a minimum anchor radius
crop_landmark_observability.census: Every source circle feature is classified; each unobservable image landmark needs strict interior coverage by other original copper with no shared boundary, or a source-derived radius at/below the existing four-pixel erosion-peak floor
crop_landmark_observability.required: All other complete in-window resolvable circles, including partially covered, boundary-touching and coincident-visible-outline sources, enter the unchanged landmark matcher
crop_landmark_observability.acceptance: Existing minimum six landmarks, 80 percent matches, .020 mm tolerance, image IoU/boundary/uniqueness predicates and negative controls unchanged
crop_landmark_observability.source_coverage: Image-landmark eligibility does not omit any native copper from source inventory, T01, T03, T04 or clearance context
crop_landmark_observability.audit: Independently recompute the full census and matches; altered classifications halt even if their metadata hash is updated

next_stage: U05 = U04 + T05; not implemented or executed by U04
